invariants: The original native cancel button offers clearSearch: on the existing command filter before its original target/action runs. An unrecognized command returns -1 and retains original immediate behavior; a handled command can be suppressed or committed by its application later.

The shared receipt carries target/control/serial/host epoch plus the native item identifier. Both browser adapters consume it after their original trusted click dispatch and validate cancellation, owner identity, enabled state and focus before committing.

Commit uses the existing semantic activation API, invoking the original cancel NSButtonCell performClickWithFrame:inView: with its original NSSearchFieldCell cancelButtonRectForBounds:. A scoped recursion guard prevents a second deferred request. No clear operation, geometry, highlight drawing or native control is copied.

After click callbacks, each adapter synchronizes its canonical model and enters its existing engine edit transaction. Original beforeinput/input, page mutation/cancellation and retirement remain in that transaction. Focus diversion does not edit another field.

Keyboard-only transactions do not commit a pending clear. Chromium invalidates that control receipt when a real key ends pointer tracking, preserving the key edit and preventing a delayed clear on mouse release.

The public API stays version 1/592; only optional capability 256 and existing selectors/item semantics change. Provider probes cover old search/no-search providers and original-action fallback. Pinned browser compatibility cohorts exercise both old-adapter/new-provider and new-adapter/old-provider directions.
Browser executables and underlying AppKit are unchanged. Toolbars/address bars/tabs keep their current components, with future optional app patches consuming the same shared native UI provider.
